config.status: HOLDOUT APPROVED by the owner 2026-11-07. Nothing here has been run on real data. Fitting refuses until holdout.approved_by is set by the owner AND the workflow variable PHASE2_RETRAIN_ENABLED is 'true'.

data.source_note: committed = src.data_loader.load_all_matches on the committed banks/sidecars with the football-data download switched off and the network blocked, so the frame is exactly the committed, corrected data and its hash is reproducible. Every loader correction (identity, one-match, history corrections, written-back cells not served, impossible stats missing, negative-margin O/U pairs flagged) applies because the loader applies it.
data.require_present_note: pipeline.mode_train's training filter (home_scored_last5) on both sides: a fixture with no rolling form is a blind fixture, which serving never tips, so it is neither trained on nor scored.

holdout.approval_note: Owner 2026-11-07: holdout from 2026-04-01 (the recommended middle option: Standard 6/17 and new-format 10/15 leagues reach the per-league minimum of 150 holdout matches). Proposed earlier: 2026-07-01. Pass rules: the PG-1.0 values in 'comparison' reused as declared. New-format HT block: included as a CANDIDATE (owner_decisions.new_format_ht_variant), never forced in.
holdout.note: UNTOUCHED final holdout. Rows dated start..end (inclusive) are never in any walk-forward fold, never used to fit, calibrate, blend or choose anything, and are scored exactly once by the holdout stage. The owner confirmed the dates (approved_by/approved_at, 2026-11-07); fitting refuses whenever approved_by or approved_at is empty, and the dates must not change for this harness_version.

walk_forward.unit_note: A matchday is one calendar date on which the track has at least one eligible row. Every cut is on whole dates, so no date is split between a training window and a test block.
walk_forward.validation_note: The last validation_matchdays of each training window are the VALIDATION block: the model+market blend weights are fitted there and nowhere else. Base models of model+market are fitted on the training window minus that block.

owner_decisions.new_format_ht_variant_note: Train new_format candidates twice: with the champion exclusion list, and with the HT block (home/away_ht_* form, ht strength, combined_ht_goals_avg, has_ht_history) restored. Each variant is a separate candidate in the Holm family ('<name>' and '<name>+ht'; market_only and dixon_coles read no features and run once). Implemented in src/retrain_harness (protocol.feature_sets / candidate_runs); if the variant cannot run (no HT column in the exclusion list, an HT column outside the feature groups or missing from the frame), fitting is refused, never skipped.

config.markets_note: O/U 2.5 is one probability (P over); its Under side is 1 - P, so log loss, Brier and calibration are the same number for both sides and are reported once, while CLV is reported per side. A market whose price has only one side in the frame (BTTS yes, Over 1.5, Over 3.5) cannot be de-vigged without inventing a margin, so it gets no market-only or model+market probability. HT markets have no price in the frame.

form.parity: ROW_LEVEL_VALIDATED (reports/P0_TRAIN_SERVE_PARITY_VALIDATION.md: 30 adversarial cases, 164 real fixtures, 0 mismatches)

form_derived.parity: DERIVED: arithmetic of validated form columns and the as-of league goal average; not separately row-validated

features.never_model_inputs_note: Price-derived. In the history the O/U price is closing-preferred (AvgC first), which no model can know at bet time (P0 bug 5). Prices enter ONLY through the market-only and model+market candidates, labelled with their price class.
features.track_exclude_note: new_format keeps the serving champion's exclusion list (pipeline.mode_train _NF_DROP) so the retrained champion recipe is the same recipe. Owner 2026-11-07: the HT block comes back for new_format as an ADDITIONAL candidate variant (see owner_decisions.new_format_ht_variant); the holdout decides, nothing is forced in.

champion_recipe.what: src.model.train_repaired (the scheduled-retrain recipe: LR + GB (+ LightGBM if installed), Platt on its CALIBRATION block, meta-logistic on its META block), retrained on the repaired frame. Imputation: missing-indicator columns plus the 1.1 train-only imputer persisted in the payload; a feature with no training value is dropped, never filled.

logistic.what: LogisticRegression on standardised features, missing-indicator columns, a median imputer fitted on the training window only and pickled with the model (scikit-learn Pipeline). Columns with no training value are dropped.

hgb.what: HistGradientBoostingClassifier, NaN-native: nothing is filled at train or serve time; a missing value follows its own learned branch.

dixon_coles.what: Per-league Dixon-Coles score distribution (src.goal_distribution matrix and tau), strengths from the training window only, rho fitted by maximum likelihood on the training window, every market from one matrix. A club or league with no training match gets NO probability (the research class's 1.0 strength / 1.4-1.1 goal fallbacks are not used).

market_only.what: The de-vigged price (power method, src.market_anchor.power_devig) of a TWO-SIDED pair. One-sided or flagged pairs give no probability.

model_market.what: Logistic stack on [logit p_base, logit p_market]; base = the 'hgb' candidate fitted on the training window minus the validation block; stack weights fitted on the VALIDATION block only. A row without a two-sided price gets no probability.

price_class.note: The committed frame holds one O/U 2.5 pair per match: football-data rows prefer the closing columns (AvgC, MaxC, B365C, PC) and fall back to pre-closing ones; new-format rows come from captured snapshots. So market_only is a CLOSING-MARKET BENCHMARK and model+market built on it is NOT deployable (a closing price is not known at bet time). An entry-class price (football-data non-C columns, src.standard_repair.load_fd_entry_prices) is attached only when --fd-raw is given; CLV needs both an entry and a closing price.

comparison.rows: COMMON rows only: every compared probability must exist on the row
comparison.test: one-sided paired bootstrap over MATCH DATES of the mean per-row log-loss difference (candidate - reference); p = (k + 1) / (B + 1) where k counts bootstrap means >= 0
comparison.family: every (stage, track, market, candidate) comparison in one run
comparison.better_means: Holm-adjusted p < family_alpha AND mean log-loss improvement >= min_effect_logloss AND n >= min_n_rows AND Brier not worse by more than max_brier_worsening AND matchdays >= min_matchdays
comparison.thresholds_source: config/promotion_gate.json PG-1.0 holdout block (declared 2026-10-25, before any candidate was scored): material_ll_improvement, min_n_per_track, max_brier_worsening, min_bootstrap_blocks, min_league_n, n_boot, bootstrap_seed, ece_bins. Reused, not re-chosen. family_alpha = 1 - ci_level.
comparison.verdict_words: BETTER_THAN_REFERENCE | NOT_SHOWN_BETTER | INSUFFICIENT_N | NOT_COMPARABLE. These are forecasting-quality statements only. No verdict promotes anything: promotion is the owner's decision.

clv.requires: a real entry price AND a real closing price for the side (columns odds_<market>_<side>_entry / odds_<market>_<side>_close, attached only with --fd-raw, today O/U 2.5 Standard only)
clv.selection: a side is counted when p_side x entry_odds > 1 (the model's fair price beats the entry price); no other filter

outputs.run_folder: every artifact goes to --out/<run_id>/; the folder must be outside models/ and output/, and no serving model file is ever written
outputs.promotion: never automatic; nothing in the harness calls src.promotion_gate or writes models/registry

promotion: none - the owner decides; this run wrote no serving file
